title: Add Simple Image Generator to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Simple Image Generator](https://xzeyrix.github.io/Simple-Image-Generator) to image
- A simple client-side image generator powered by Pollinations. Users sign in with their Pollinations account and generate images directly in the browser using their own Pollen balance. The app supports

Fixes #15481

gist.headline: A little image garden
gist.blurb: Simple Image Generator joins the app collection. Sign in with Pollinations, type a prompt, and make images in your browser using your own Pollen.
gist.summary: Added Simple Image Generator to the app collection, a client-side app that lets users sign in with Pollinations and generate images in their browser using their own Pollen balance.
gist.impact: Users can find Simple Image Generator in the app collection and make images through its browser-based interface with their Pollinations account.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the new browser-based image generator as a cozy retro computer turning a typed prompt into a framed pixel picture, with a small Pollen wallet icon beside it. Polli, wearing a tiny painter's beret, helps at the keyboard; flowers and code-plants make the scene feel like a shared creative workspace. No separate app mascot is identified.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli wears a tiny painter's beret and taps a retro browser terminal as a prompt becomes a framed picture; a small Pollen wallet icon, flowers, and code-plants sit nearby. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never dominating the scene, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
